text.description_html:
AHI SIG715-630 Contemporary Oval Stainless Flush Pull

This is a contemporary design oval shape sliding door flush pull for use on pocket doors, sliding doors, cabinet doors--any door where a "flush with the door face" pull is desired. Made of stainless steel, it has a satin finish. Extremely resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches and abrasion making it an ideal material for door hardware. It needs little looking after and does not degrade in appearance or function with use.

Specifications for the AHI SIG715-630 Contemporary Oval Stainless Flush Pull:

  • Material: 1/16" Thick Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Total Height: 4.75" (120 mm)
  • Total Width: 1.6" (40 mm)
  • Total Depth: 1/2" (12 mm)
  • Door Cutout Depth: 3/8" (10 mm)
  • Projection: 1/16" (2 mm)
  • Packaged with matching satin stainless mounting screws.

Sold Individually
